description: Source code for the sib1_scheduler class, managing scheduling and transmission of SIB1 messages in a 5G NR network, including resource allocation, DCI generation, and update handling.

classes.name: sib1_scheduler
classes.description: Manages scheduling, resource allocation, and transmission of SIB1 messages in 5G NR.

methods.name: sib1_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scheduler with configuration, resource allocator, and payload size.

methods.name: handle_sib1_update_indication
methods.description: Updates the pending SIB1 version and size based on external indication.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Performs scheduling for a given slot, allocating resources for SIB1 if needed.

methods.name: allocate_sib1
methods.description: Allocates resources for SIB1 in a given slot and beam, including DCI and PDSCH configuration.

methods.name: fill_sib1_grant
methods.description: Fills in the DCI and PDSCH configuration for SIB1 grant.

methods.name: handle_pending_sib1_update
methods.description: Applies pending SIB1 updates if the version has changed.
